a: ध्मा — {c1c} P. (धमति, ध्मात; caus. ध्मापयति) 1 To blow, breathe out, exhale. --2 To blow (as a wind-instrument), produce sound by blowing; शंखं दधमौ प्रतापवान् Bg. 1. 12, 18; R. 7. 63; Bk. 3. 34; 17. 7. --3 To blow a fire, excite fire by blowing, excite sparks; को धमेच्छांतं च पावकं Mb. --4 To manufacture by blowing. --5 To cast, blow, or throw away.
ध्मां(ध्वां)क्ष् — {c1c} P. (ध्मांक्षति) 1 To crow, or caw. --2 To desire.
